scenarios.title: First purchase
scenarios.opening: A seller keeps the small bag in his pocket. The tram unloads twice while Aatami watches who stays.

choices.label: Buy one pack — €45
choices.forecast: Gain stock and the €68 Siltasaari demand lead; become a known customer.

choices.label: Ask who keeps watching
choices.forecast: Keep cash, gain a faction lead, spend the block.

choices.label: Walk away
choices.forecast: Preserve cash. The offer returns at night with a colder reception.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Public tram-square approach: moving crowd edges, stable meeting pool, paper offer and seller; reveal watcher/exit/crew changes on later visits.

scenarios.title: The receipt envelope
scenarios.opening: Jaska cuts old receipts into a city that refuses to line up. A sealed envelope of markka props up one corner.

choices.label: Ask before taking the envelope
choices.forecast: Gain dead money and preserve trust.

choices.label: Call it family money
choices.forecast: Gain dead money; Jaska remembers the wording.

choices.label: Leave the old money under the map
choices.forecast: Lose a bank opportunity; deepen trust.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Scene Club near Mäkelänsilta: entrance availability lamp, receipt city, envelope and family photo; intimate worktable framing. Courtyard event needs a separate site binding.

scenarios.title: First sale
scenarios.opening: The buyer waits outside the legitimate queue, annoyed that Aatami arrived before she invented a reason to be there.

choices.label: Complete the first sale
choices.forecast: Gain €68 and price history; the route becomes visible.

choices.label: Trade margin for an introduction
choices.forecast: Gain €55 and the first runner lead.

choices.label: Keep walking with the queue
choices.forecast: Preserve stock; lose the current quote.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Siltasaari public approach and staffed-bank interior are two views of one service: outside buyer/queue, then ticket counter/mirror/notice. No illicit exchange inside the teller service.

scenarios.title: Runner at the tram stop
scenarios.opening: The runner has already read the timetable, and read Aatami. She asks which one of them is more reliable.

choices.label: Offer €18 per night and no waiting games
choices.forecast: Recruit her with a clear wage and a promise she will remember.

choices.label: Offer €10 and future work
choices.forecast: She joins for one job; loyalty starts low.

choices.label: Pay €8 for the route observation
choices.forecast: Gain intel without recruiting.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Harju tram-stop edge: timetable, messenger bag and uninterrupted public path; recruitment is a face-to-face wage/promise decision.

scenarios.title: The bank counter
scenarios.opening: A paper clock marks the queue. The teller explains that nostalgia has no exchange-rate bonus.

choices.label: Convert all carried markka
choices.forecast: Receive the fixed euro equivalent; the block and visible visit are the cost.

choices.label: Convert 120 mk
choices.forecast: Keep some dead money for a later family choice.

choices.label: Leave before your number
choices.forecast: Keep the old cash and preserve the block's legitimacy cover only in memory.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Siltasaari public approach and staffed-bank interior are two views of one service: outside buyer/queue, then ticket counter/mirror/notice. No illicit exchange inside the teller service.

scenarios.title: Slomo lowers his voice
scenarios.opening: Toko dries a bowl and lowers his voice. Three delivery vans. Thursday. One of them is empty.

choices.label: Buy information — €120
choices.forecast: Confirm a safe description and unlock the Harju range.

choices.label: Risk sabotage — €300
choices.forecast: 45% success is visible. Failure costs trust and may close a route.

choices.label: Eat, listen, owe a favour
choices.forecast: Gain a direction rather than a quote; Toko records the favour.

choices.label: Leave
choices.forecast: Keep cash; the uncertain mission remains available.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Vaasankatu approach -> lit doorway -> counter. Bowl, repaired radio, tally marks and tram window carry distinct inspectable facts. Slomo stays a narrative person.

scenarios.title: The park watcher
scenarios.opening: Wind turns the lime leaves. The watcher points out the same man crossing the park without ever arriving.

choices.label: Hire the watcher — €24 per night
choices.forecast: Recruit a watcher and reveal intent more clearly in the coming mission.

choices.label: Pay €10 for the observation
choices.forecast: Gain one-use intent clarity without a wage.

choices.label: Watch the dog instead
choices.forecast: Lower immediate pressure; enter the mission with poorer information.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Park approach, bench and contact, with the authored bear/plinth, readable withdrawal path and discrete cover when combat starts. The gazebo concept is mood study, not a sufficient Bear Path battle layout.

scenarios.title: McCormick yard
scenarios.opening: The public room closes. In the yard, three relatives disagree about the same invoice at full volume.

choices.label: Hire the muscle — €28 per night
choices.forecast: Recruit muscle; owe the family no extra favour.

choices.label: Buy the repaired bat — €35
choices.forecast: Unlock two-handed close pressure.

choices.label: Take gear against a future favour
choices.forecast: Gain a bat and pipe; the family chooses a later obligation.

choices.label: Keep the relationship in the public room
choices.forecast: No equipment; lower faction entanglement.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Public venue -> service yard near the Linjat/Siltanen area. Family photograph, invoice and repaired equipment distinguish purchase, recruitment and obligation.

scenarios.title: Bear Path
scenarios.status: authored_content; C.07 standalone 3D encounter implemented; physical-device and campaign acceptance pending
scenarios.opening: Two men wait on the wrong side of the granite bear. One keeps glancing toward a van that is not coming.

choices.label: Name the empty van
choices.forecast: Avoid battle and complete a controlled handover.

choices.label: Let the fixer speak
choices.forecast: A readable negotiation check; failure starts the 2v2 with neutral formation.

choices.label: Hold the path
choices.forecast: Begin the 2v2. No death outcome; wounds and missing status are possible.

choices.label: Leave with the package
choices.forecast: Fail safely; lose the contact for one day.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Park approach, bench and contact, with the authored bear/plinth, readable withdrawal path and discrete cover when combat starts. The gazebo concept is mood study, not a sufficient Bear Path battle layout.

scenarios.title: The first firearm
scenarios.opening: The seller has remembered Aatami's questions. This time the object under the coat changes every answer in the square.

choices.label: Buy the first handgun — €180
choices.forecast: Unlock armed loadouts and raise Piritori pressure. It is not required to finish the slice.

choices.label: Trade a McCormick favour
choices.forecast: Gain the weapon; transfer the obligation into family leverage.

choices.label: Refuse the weapon
choices.forecast: Keep the money. Battle-capable means crew and preparation, not mandatory gun ownership.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Public tram-square approach: moving crowd edges, stable meeting pool, paper offer and seller; reveal watcher/exit/crew changes on later visits.

scenarios.title: The restaurant front
scenarios.opening: Mei Lan serves the lunch queue before acknowledging Aatami. The restaurant is a workplace first and a faction door only if she opens it.

choices.label: Ask about the duplicate invoice
choices.forecast: Reveal the courtyard recovery mission without accusing the staff.

choices.label: Buy lunch and wait
choices.forecast: Spend €12; gain a rumour and preserve the relationship.

choices.label: Push for the back room
choices.forecast: Open the mission faster; begin with faction distrust.

choices.label: Leave with the lunch crowd
choices.forecast: Keep the teaser unresolved; the courtyard signal arrives by SMS.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Working restaurant first: lunch crowd, invoice and socially gated back-room door. Staff retain civilian identities; faction access is authored, not a universal enemy switch.

scenarios.title: Courtyard last call
scenarios.opening: The receipt envelope lies inside the porttikongi. Warm windows turn off one by one as both teams decide who will make the courtyard remember them.

choices.label: Trade the Jade introduction
choices.forecast: Start negotiation before the 3v3; a partial account is possible.

choices.label: Take positions
choices.forecast: Start the 3v3. Critical wounds are possible and telegraphed; retreat remains available.

choices.label: Leave the receipts
choices.forecast: Fail the recovery without combat; protect Jaska's home and reduce pressure.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Scene Club near Mäkelänsilta: entrance availability lamp, receipt city, envelope and family photo; intimate worktable framing. Courtyard event needs a separate site binding.

scenarios.title: What the ledger leaves
scenarios.opening: A brochure shows a clean Pasila flat with no routes drawn on it. The ledger beside it refuses the same fantasy.

choices.label: Pay debt before the exit fund
choices.forecast: Reduce immediate threat; Pasila remains farther away in cash.

choices.label: Ring-fence the exit fund
choices.forecast: Move €120 toward Pasila; debt pressure persists.

choices.label: Treat critical wounds first
choices.forecast: Prevent a known death risk; accept a weaker financial ending.

choices.label: Ask Jaska what Eden costs
choices.forecast: Gain no money; unlock the honest final conversation.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Siltasaari public approach and staffed-bank interior are two views of one service: outside buyer/queue, then ticket counter/mirror/notice. No illicit exchange inside the teller service.

scenarios.title: Jaska’s last light
scenarios.opening: Jaska has pasted every route receipt into the cardboard city. Pasila is a blank shape cut from the edge.
inspectables: empty portrait space if someone died

choices.label: Call the move Eden
choices.forecast: Close the slice with Aatami defending the plan.

choices.label: Name what the routes cost
choices.forecast: Close with a harder family truth; no morality score is awarded.

choices.label: Take Jaska's cardboard map
choices.forecast: Carry the Kallio network into the future literally and mechanically.

choices.label: Leave the map unfinished
choices.forecast: Pasila remains a possibility rather than a victory screen.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Scene Club near Mäkelänsilta: entrance availability lamp, receipt city, envelope and family photo; intimate worktable framing. Courtyard event needs a separate site binding.

scenarios.title: ROOM TO WORK
scenarios.opening: Jaska turns a scrap of cardboard over, looking for an unmarked side. "You can sit for a minute. Just leave that pile where it is." He makes room beside the table without stopping work.

choices.label: Sit and ask about the work
choices.forecast: Remember that you stayed to listen. No money or time-block cost.

choices.label: Give him room to work
choices.forecast: Remember that you respected his space. No money or time-block cost.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Scene Club near Mäkelänsilta: entrance availability lamp, receipt city, envelope and family photo; intimate worktable framing. Courtyard event needs a separate site binding.

scenarios.title: AFTER SERVICE
scenarios.opening: Slomo sets a dry bowl beside the others. The radio crackles, then finds its station. "Not every visit has to be business," he says. For a moment, the tram outside is the loudest thing in the room.

choices.label: Ask how the evening went
choices.forecast: Remember a conversation about his shop. No information or money reward.

choices.label: Keep him company quietly
choices.forecast: Remember sharing a quiet moment. No information or money reward.

scenarios.spatial_proposal: Vaasankatu approach -> lit doorway -> counter. Bowl, repaired radio, tally marks and tram window carry distinct inspectable facts. Slomo stays a narrative person.

news.documented: Markka notes and coins ceased to be legal tender after February 2002. The irrevocable conversion rate is 5.94573 markka per euro, and redemption remained available through the Bank of Finland until 29 February 2012.
news.inference: Old cash can still appear in homes and informal payments even though ordinary shops cannot treat it as current money.
news.fiction: The slice's staffed Siltasaari counter and its visibility consequences are fictional gameplay services.
news.arvo_copy: The markka is no longer money at the till. Its value is fixed; recovering that value still requires a journey.

chapter_endings.label: The shipment
chapter_endings.brief: A container comes off a ship at Sörnäinen. Pay for it, move it, and be somewhere else by morning.

resolved_decisions.question: Which of the six angle/detail scenes should guide the art, and what should change?
resolved_decisions.owner_answer: All of these are great, but we also need to zoom out for battle a bit, maybe dynamic. Test horizontal as well. Other types of scenes and so on.
resolved_decisions.interpretation: v01/v02 environmental visual direction approved. Wider battle framing and landscape/scene-variety exploration requested. Exact geography, layouts, generated signs, new character identities and runtime implementation are not approved by this answer.

resolved_decisions.owner_answer: All are nice but middle and right ones are realistic for us and approved
resolved_decisions.interpretation: Middle and right columns of the v03 six-panel sheet: panels 02, 03, 05 and 06 are approved environment/framing targets for implementation.

remaining_panels.status: reference_only; not selected for implementation by this approval; not rejected

resolved_decisions.scope: Use the approved spatial scale, elevated framing, mood and scene types as build targets. Exact generated text/geography, final asset quality and automatic camera policy require their existing checks. This records owner approval, not engine/device acceptance.
